title: Expansion of the cycle-route network and cycling measures
description: As transport director she oversaw cycling-infrastructure measures, including reportedly seven new cycle streets (Velostrassen), additional cycle lanes and routes, and about 660 new bicycle parking spaces at the main station. She stated the planned cycle-route network was about one-third built out.
role: Director for Civil Engineering, Transport and Urban Greenery (responsible directorate)

title: Traffic-calming of the street network
description: Under her directorate, traffic-calmed zones grew to over 60 percent of Bern's street network.
role: Director for Civil Engineering, Transport and Urban Greenery

title: Redesign of public squares (e.g. Breitenrainplatz)
description: Urban-greening and public-space projects under her directorate, such as the redesigned Breitenrainplatz with seating, fountains and trees, intended as a model for heat-resilient public space.
role: Director for Civil Engineering, Transport and Urban Greenery

title: Coloured-bag / container recycling scheme (Farbsack und Containerpflicht)
description: Recycling scheme handled by her directorate; she publicly acknowledged that progress on the coloured-bag waste-separation system and the associated container requirement had fallen short of the directorate's own expectations.
role: Director for Civil Engineering, Transport and Urban Greenery

title: Releasing Bernmobil from the obligation to buy electricity from EWB
description: The city executive relaxed Bernmobil's obligation to purchase electricity exclusively from Energie Wasser Bern, freeing the municipal transport operator to procure electricity on more favourable terms; reporting noted this also removed a potential conflict of interest for Kruit as a Bernmobil board member.
